|strategy=By [mailto:DougRed4@aol.com Doug Taylor]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/quigonjinnslightsaber.html</ref>

Continuing in the great tradition of the most powerful weapons in the game, the Light side now has another powerful unique lightsaber to add to their arsenal.

In addition to the always strong "ordinary" uses, like adding to a Force drain or cleaving targets like a ginsu knife, this elegant tool has a few additional benefits. Many of the new "Jedi helpers" ([[A Jedi's Concentration]], [[A Jedi's Focus]], and [[A Jedi's Patience]]) require your Knight or Master to be armed with a lightsaber, and thus Qui-Gon will be at his most efficient when he has his. You'll also find that Qui-Gon armed with his weapon is a tank, and when he holds it he joins Jedi [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] as one of the few Light side characters able to safely hold down a site all by himself.
